Hi Asha — great to hear, and glad the demo was useful.

Short answer: we can potentially do an invoice-only onboarding for a short pilot, but it requires a narrow set of controls and approvals on our side. To move quickly, please confirm the following so I can run this for approval with Procurement and Billing:

- Final estimated pilot spend and billing cadence (monthly/once)
- Billing contact and invoice email (who signs invoices)
- Signed SOW (we can accept the draft you sent; we just need an executed PDF)
- Proof of security posture: SOC 2 Type II report OR equivalent attestation and the name of your auditor
- Bank/payment remit details for invoice processing

Karthik / Monica — looping you in. Per procurement policy, invoice-only exceptions under $25k per year can be approved with SOC2 + signed SOW + 60-day NET terms. If anything else is needed (KYC/POA), let me know.

Asha — once we have those items I’ll get a temporary exception approval and a billing route set up (we typically create an invoice-only vendor record and route invoices to Billing for net terms processing).

Next step: Asha, could you send the signed SOW and SOC2 link? Monica will provision the account once approved.

Best,

   - SOC2 Type II report available and internal summary reviewed (we have vendor portal link)
